@Test
public void readsUncompressedBlocks() throws IOException {
    final byte[] input = new byte[] { // signature
    4, // signature
    0x22, // signature
    0x4d, // signature
    0x18, // flag - Version 01, block independent, no block checksum, no content size, no content checksum
    0x60, // block size 4MB
    0x70, // checksum
    115, // 13 bytes length and uncompressed bit set
    13, // 13 bytes length and uncompressed bit set
    0, // 13 bytes length and uncompressed bit set
    0, // 13 bytes length and uncompressed bit set
    (byte) 0x80, // content
    'H', // content
    'e', // content
    'l', // content
    'l', // content
    'o', // content
    ',', // content
    ' ', // content
    'w', // content
    'o', // content
    'r', // content
    'l', // content
    'd', // content
    '!', // empty block marker
    0, // empty block marker
    0, // empty block marker
    0, // empty block marker
    0 };
    try (InputStream a = new FramedLZ4CompressorInputStream(new ByteArrayInputStream(input))) {
        final byte[] actual = IOUtils.toByteArray(a);
        assertArrayEquals(new byte[] { 'H', 'e', 'l', 'l', 'o', ',', ' ', 'w', 'o', 'r', 'l', 'd', '!' }, actual);
    }
}

@Test
public void skipsOverSkippableFrames() throws IOException {
    final byte[] input = new byte[] { // signature
    4, // signature
    0x22, // signature
    0x4d, // signature
    0x18, // flag - Version 01, block independent, no block checksum, no content size, no content checksum
    0x60, // block size 4MB
    0x70, // checksum
    115, // 13 bytes length and uncompressed bit set
    13, // 13 bytes length and uncompressed bit set
    0, // 13 bytes length and uncompressed bit set
    0, // 13 bytes length and uncompressed bit set
    (byte) 0x80, // content
    'H', // content
    'e', // content
    'l', // content
    'l', // content
    'o', // content
    ',', // content
    ' ', // content
    'w', // content
    'o', // content
    'r', // content
    'l', // content
    'd', // content
    '!', // empty block marker
    0, // empty block marker
    0, // empty block marker
    0, // empty block marker
    0, // skippable frame signature
    0x5f, // skippable frame signature
    0x2a, // skippable frame signature
    0x4d, // skippable frame signature
    0x18, // skippable frame has length 2
    2, // skippable frame has length 2
    0, // skippable frame has length 2
    0, // skippable frame has length 2
    0, // content of skippable frame
    1, // content of skippable frame
    2, // signature
    4, // signature
    0x22, // signature
    0x4d, // signature
    0x18, // flag - Version 01, block independent, no block checksum, no content size, no content checksum
    0x60, // block size 4MB
    0x70, // checksum
    115, // 1 bytes length and uncompressed bit set
    1, // 1 bytes length and uncompressed bit set
    0, // 1 bytes length and uncompressed bit set
    0, // 1 bytes length and uncompressed bit set
    (byte) 0x80, // content
    '!', // empty block marker
    0, // empty block marker
    0, // empty block marker
    0, // empty block marker
    0 };
    try (InputStream a = new FramedLZ4CompressorInputStream(new ByteArrayInputStream(input), true)) {
        final byte[] actual = IOUtils.toByteArray(a);
        assertArrayEquals(new byte[] { 'H', 'e', 'l', 'l', 'o', ',', ' ', 'w', 'o', 'r', 'l', 'd', '!', '!' }, actual);
    }
}

public void rejectsSkippableFrameFollowedByJunk() {
    final byte[] input = new byte[] { // signature
    4, // signature
    0x22, // signature
    0x4d, // signature
    0x18, // flag - Version 01, block independent, no block checksum, no content size, no content checksum
    0x60, // block size 4MB
    0x70, // checksum
    115, // 13 bytes length and uncompressed bit set
    13, // 13 bytes length and uncompressed bit set
    0, // 13 bytes length and uncompressed bit set
    0, // 13 bytes length and uncompressed bit set
    (byte) 0x80, // content
    'H', // content
    'e', // content
    'l', // content
    'l', // content
    'o', // content
    ',', // content
    ' ', // content
    'w', // content
    'o', // content
    'r', // content
    'l', // content
    'd', // content
    '!', // empty block marker
    0, // empty block marker
    0, // empty block marker
    0, // empty block marker
    0, // skippable frame signature
    0x50, // skippable frame signature
    0x2a, // skippable frame signature
    0x4d, // skippable frame signature
    0x18, // skippable frame has length 2
    2, // skippable frame has length 2
    0, // skippable frame has length 2
    0, // skippable frame has length 2
    0, // content of skippable frame
    1, // content of skippable frame
    2, // bad signature
    1, // bad signature
    0x22, // bad signature
    0x4d, // bad signature
    0x18 };
    try {
        try (InputStream a = new FramedLZ4CompressorInputStream(new ByteArrayInputStream(input), true)) {
            IOUtils.toByteArray(a);
            fail("expected exception");
        }
    } catch (final IOException ex) {
        assertThat(ex.getMessage(), containsString("garbage"));
    }
}

    4, // signature
    0x22, // signature
    0x4d, // signature
    0x18, // flag - Version 01, block independent, no block checksum, no content size, no content checksum
    0x60, // block size 4MB
    0x70, // checksum
    115, // 13 bytes length and uncompressed bit set
    13, // 13 bytes length and uncompressed bit set
    0, // 13 bytes length and uncompressed bit set
    0, // 13 bytes length and uncompressed bit set
    (byte) 0x80, // content
    'H', // content
    'e', // content
    'l', // content
    'l', // content
    'o', // content
    ',', // content
    ' ', // content
    'w', // content
    'o', // content
    'r', // content
    'l', // content
    'd', // content
    '!', // empty block marker
    0, // empty block marker
    0, // empty block marker
    0, // empty block marker
    0, // skippable frame signature
    0x50, // skippable frame signature
    0x2a, // skippable frame signature
    0x4d, // skippable frame signature
    0x18, // skippable frame has length 2
    2, // skippable frame has length 2
    0, // skippable frame has length 2
